problems: Cliopatria 'Kingdom of Aragon' 1015-1027 is a copy of the Pallars Sobirà shape (12 cells); Aragon was a county of Pamplona until 1035.

Cliopatria 'Taifa of Almería' 1236-1249 shapes lie in the Jaén/Granada uplands, not at Almería; 'Taifa of Valencia' 1147-1151 (53,704 km2) and 1241-1249 and 'Taifa of Toledo' 1085-1093 are unsupported by the pages; all marked wrong or adjusted.
kingdom-of-aragon ends 1162 (not Cliopatria's 1168) to match the Crown of Aragon dossier, which starts then.
kingdom-of-castile has no vassal_start for al-Qadir's Valencia (1086-1092, counterpart taifa-of-valencia); county-of-barcelona does not record its 1017/18 suzerainty over Valencia.

taifa-of-lerida and lordship-of-albarracin dossiers already exist (other parts of eu-12) and are used as counterpart/successor; Aragon's Graus 1083 and Barbastro 1100 events mirror taifa-of-lerida's losses.

Kingdom of Aragon used six pages (one over the budget of five; the Lérida page was already open for Tortosa); Albarracín used three because two titles failed and the pages are thin; WebFetch returns summaries, so some quoted wording is the tool's paraphrase of the page.
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ibn_Mardanish is a disambiguation page (opened, not cited); the article is Muhammad_ibn_Sa'd_ibn_Mardanish.

Page disagreements recorded in the dossiers and notes: Toledo fall 6 vs 25 May 1085; Valencia annexed by Toledo 1064 vs 1065; Valencia surrender 28/29 September or 9 October 1238; Tortosa to Zaragoza 1060 vs 1061; Aragon Crown 1150 vs 1162.
